entries.summary: The embedded server's SQLite file is now schema 8 (#1113 A2b): the activity log is persisted in the database instead of process memory, so task activity and its cursors survive a restart, and the terminal-task archive removes it in its own transaction. A schema 6 or 7 file is upgraded in place when it opens, inside the open transaction, keeping its pairings, tasks, approvals and other rows; 7 to 8 adds activity_log_head and activity_log_entry empty, since no activity history was persisted before. The upgrade is one-way: 0.32.0 and earlier refuse a schema 8 file, so stop the server and back up the database file before the first open with this release. A v8 file missing either table is refused as SQLITE_SCHEMA_INVALID.
